agent.runner_summary: Runs one user text turn through airline.NewAgent() when provider credentials are available, with an offline deterministic baggage-policy fallback used only for credential-free local validation.

log_notes: The adapter public input is a raw string user turn.
The project exposes three direct model-facing local tools in airline/tools.go: lookup_booking, baggage_policy, and change_seat.
Provider selection is environment-driven in airline.SelectModel(): OPENAI_API_KEY is preferred over ANTHROPIC_API_KEY; OPENAI_MODEL and ANTHROPIC_MODEL optionally override defaults.
Session logs are JSONL under logs/ by default, or AIRLINE_SUPPORT_LOG_DIR when set.
learning_env_guidance: Use plain-text airline customer prompts as the turn content.
For credential-free smoke or static validation, prefer baggage-policy scenarios because the adapter has a deterministic offline fallback only for that behavior.
Booking-specific or seat-change learning environments require live provider credentials so the real agent can decide when to call tools and how to phrase the response.
